exposure: Type of IA (spondylitis/spondyloarthritis vs. rheumatoid arthritis)
Etanercept treatment for inflammatory arthropathy (IA) during pregnancy
outcome: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. natural delivery)
cohort: 25 pregnant patients with IA treated with etanercept
finding: While most patients (84%) and newborns (96%) did not experience adverse outcomes, larger studies are needed to make definitive conclusions about the safety of etanercept during pregnancy.
